columns.description: The course section number.

columns.description: A unique number that is used to link this section to the related records in other tables.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: The description of the course-section.

columns.name: STUDY_HALL
columns.description: Indicates if the course is a study hall that will be scheduled using the Schedule Study Halls option.

columns.name: MAXIMUM_SEATS
columns.description: The maximum number of students that can be scheduled in the course- section.

columns.name: DEPARTMENT
columns.description: The code for the department offering the course.

columns.name: VOTEC
columns.description: Indicates if course-section is a vocational technical/career technology course.

columns.name: FEE
columns.description: Indicates the fee associated with this course-section.

columns.name: GENDER_RESTRICTION
columns.description: The gender of students who can be scheduled in the course-section.

columns.name: BLOCK_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether this section is a block, blockette, or neither. "N (Regular course), B (Block course), C (Blockette)"

columns.name: TRACK
columns.description: The scheduling track of the course-section.

columns.name: DURATION_TYPE
columns.description: The units of duration for this section, such as M (Marking Period) or W (6 week).

columns.name: SUBJ_AREA_CREDIT
columns.description: Indicates how credit should be divided if the credit can apply to more than one subject area/requirement.  "E (Evenly divide credit among all subject areas), F (Full credit goes to all subject areas), O (Fill credit into subject areas in order)"

columns.name: AVERAGE_TYPE
columns.description: Defines the type of average that applies to this section.

columns.name: STATE_CRS_EQUIV
columns.description: Indicates if this record was created by the Build Course Equivalency option.

columns.name: SAME_TEACHER
columns.description: Indicates whether blockettes that are not assigned to a section should be taught by the same teacher.  "N (No Linking), P (Linking Preferred), R (Linking Required) "

columns.name: LOCK
columns.description: Indicates whether the section is locked.

columns.name: COURSE_CREDIT_BASIS
columns.description: The course credit basis for Student Data Exchange.

columns.name: NCES_CODE
columns.description: The National Center for Education Statistics (NCES) code for course used for Student Data Exchange.

columns.name: CATEGORY_TYPE
columns.description: The Gradebook category type assigned to this course to load pre-defined Gradebook setups for the teacher.

columns.name: CLASSIFY_STUS_MAX
columns.description: The maximum value for maximum classified students in the class.

columns.name: CLASSIFY_NUM_OR_PER

columns.name: JOIN_CONDITION
columns.description: Indicates how this record is joined in with the other records for this meeting key: And: Indicates that the conditions in meeting information row and the preceding row must both be met. Or: Indicates that the row is separate from the previous row; its conditions are unrelated. Followed By: Indicates the conditions in the current row and the previous row must both be met. This row only applies to a single period, which can occur any time after the period(s) listed in the previous row. Contiguous: Indicates the conditions in the current row and the previous row must both be met. This row only applies to a single period, which must be adjacent, either before or after the period(s) listed in the previous row.

columns.name: CYCLES_SELECTED
columns.description: Indicates on which cycle days courses assigned to this meeting code will meet: All: Indicates that the course must meet on every cycle day. Any: Indicates the course must meet on a single cycle day, but the system can select which day. Selected: Allows you to specify all the days on which the course must meet. When you choose Selected, you can enter the cycle days.

columns.name: PERIODS_SELECTED
